BIRLA INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY, MESRA, RANCHI
(MID SEMESTER EXAMINATION)
CLASS: BBA  SEMESTER : V/ADD
BRANCH: Management  SESSION : MO/2025

SUBJECT: MN411 INTERNATIONAL FINANCE
TIME: 02 Hours  FULL MARKS: 25

INSTRUCTIONS:
1. The question paper contains 5 questions each of 5 marks and total 25 marks.
2. Attempt all questions.
3. The missing data, if any, may be assumed suitably.
4. Tables/Data handbook/Graph paper etc., if applicable, will be supplied to the candidates
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


   CO BL
Q.1(a) Explain the concept of International Finance with an example. [2] 1 1
Q.1(b) “In the global economy, India has been reshaped by International Finance.” Explain
how International Finance has influenced India’s position globally.
[3] 1 2


Q.2(a) Identify and discuss at least two recent developments in global financial markets. [2] 1 2
Q.2(b) Illustrate the challenges to international financial management due to integration and
innovation.
[3] 1 2


Q.3 “Balance of Payment is more than just accounting—it is a mirror of a nation’s external
economic health.” Examine this statement by explaining the major components and
their linkages.
[5] 3 3


Q.4 “BoP signals whether an economy is strong or vulnerable.” Explain this statement with
reference to India’s 1991 Crisis, 2008 Financial Crisis, or the 2013 Taper Tantrum.
[5] 3 3


Q.5(a) “Exchange rate quotations are the language of global trade.” - Explain this statement
with a suitable example.
[2] 2 2
Q.5(b) “The foreign exchange market is a marketplace of many players” – Discuss. [3] 2 2
